_comment: Sending from the tool (Phase 1, docs/evolution.md §6). sendingDomains: who may Connect Outlook and Send (Matt, 29 Sept 2026: DreamLease only; SalSac is a later iteration). maxEmailKb: the largest email the tool sends; Gmail clips an email's HTML above about 102 KB, which would hide the compliance wording at the bottom. offerCheckedHours: an offer looked up within this many hours counts as checked on the website; older ones are looked up again at Send.
